warnings: ndc=0 (<5, the AIAG adequate-gauge bar) — ADVISORY ONLY, NOT a gate. ndc is selection-sensitive: it scales with how far apart the hand-picked configs happen to be, so it under-reports when configs cluster into a few quality tiers even on a sharp gauge. The gauge's real resolution is the guard band — lean on it and the per-config verdicts, never ndc, as the accept/reject grade.
